title: W3 common-hardware definition: H-1, C-1, common magnetic circuit, removable RF and ECR pre-ionizer modules
status_note: Requirements specification for owner review. Nothing here is approved, pre-registered or ordered. Every threshold that is not in the RFP is PROPOSED; every value without a source is TBD. No supplier, facility or lab was contacted; published product and paper data are cited as references only.

HW-0.definition: H-1 + C-1 + MC-1 + FS-C + SVC-1 with the flow-equivalent spacer PIM-0 between IP-UP and IP-DN (lane 25 HW-0; lane 37 mode M0). The only configuration reported as hall_only.

HW-RF.definition: the same H-1 + C-1 + MC-1 + FS-C + SVC-1 with the RF pre-ionizer module PIM-RF between IP-UP and IP-DN (lane 25 HW-RF; lane 37 M1 powered, M0b unpowered).

HW-ECR.definition: the same H-1 + C-1 + MC-1 + FS-C + SVC-1 with the ECR pre-ionizer module PIM-ECR between IP-UP and IP-DN (lane 25 HW-ECR; lane 37 M2 powered, M0b unpowered, M0c magnets on / microwaves off if the ECR magnet is an electromagnet).

OPTION-DIVERTER.definition: PROPOSED option of lane 25 / experiment package D-06-B: an in-vacuum feed-path diverter routes the anode gas through the installed module or directly to the anode distributor without venting. Hardware requirements in HW-PIM-13; adopted only if the owner selects D-06-B.

control_states.M0b: module installed, source unpowered (control state, architecture id none; never reported as hall_only)
control_states.M0c: ECR module installed, microwaves off, ECR electromagnet on (only possible with an electromagnet; with permanent magnets M0b = M0c, lane 37 section 3)

phases.P1: Phase 1: hall_only sustainment knee on N2 (owner disposition sequence). Hardware: H-1, C-1, MC-1, FS-C, PIM-0, SVC-1, PS-C. Module interfaces IP-UP / IP-DN and the service-line bundle must already be frozen so that the Phase-1 HW-0 installation is the same installation definition used in Phase 2.
phases.P2: Phase 2: common-condition three-arm comparison (R_arch). Adds PIM-RF and PIM-ECR with their chains.
phases.P3: Phase 3: absolute thrust demonstration on the actual delivered feed across the representative feed envelope (T_measured; sustained >= 12 mN; registered 25 mN capability; P_bus < 1.5 kW).

A.what: Defines the common hardware whose measurements produce the milestone-A statements: paired R_arch classes (Phase 2) and the absolute gate (Phase 3) for 'architecture X is baseline provided ...'. Makes the hardware identity across arms checkable (identity matrix, verification per configuration change).
next_needed: W1 feed test points (fo_feed_state_closure) for the flow and pressure ranges
a Vyovrinda H-1 design release (geometry, magnetic circuit, B(z)) and module designs
hardware readiness review HRR before S1

B.what: Requires B(z) at actual coil currents, as-built geometry, coil currents per reading and module inlet diagnostics, which are Hall-map inputs (docs/hallmap/) and candidate held-out validation evidence (W5).
next_needed: an admitted Hall transport closure (credible set is empty; gate 3 FAIL)
W5 pre-registration of which measurements are held-out evidence, filed before any data
O/O2 chemistry (W7, fo_o_o2_chemistry_v0) for the air surrogate
solver inflow capability at HALL_INLET_Z0 for rf_hall/ecr_hall (lane 17 section 8 GAP)

C.what: Flight-representative material and interface requirements are recorded as conditions; the lab hardware is not flight hardware.
next_needed: flight mass allocation (lane 21 mass BOM, RFP < 40 kg system)
wall and anode life evidence against > 15,000 h firing (lane 32 H1-H9; this campaign gives only pre/post inspection)
cathode life and O-exposure qualification (lane 10/19 gaps)

thrust_band_mN.locator: abep_sim/constants.py RFPConstraints.thrust_min_mN / thrust_max_mN (verify against the RFP text)

power_max_W.locator: abep_sim/constants.py RFPConstraints.power_max_W; RFP states < 1.5 kW; bus scope per bus_power_boundary_v1

mass_max_kg.locator: abep_sim/constants.py RFPConstraints.mass_max_kg (system-level; no H-1/C-1 allocation exists)

rfp_basis.propellants: air + Xe, Hall preferred (CLAUDE.md 'What this is'; abep_sim/constants.py RFPConstraints.hall_preferred)

absolute_thrust_gate.statement: Owner decision od_hardware_pivot: absolute thrust feasibility on the actual delivered feed within P_bus < 1.5 kW: T_measured, sustained >= 12 mN, and the registered 25 mN capability condition. P_bus is the bus_power_boundary_v1 sum (abep_sim/arch_boundary.py bus_power_ledger), never Hall discharge-only power.

registered_capability_mN.locator: OD_HARDWARE_PIVOT statement ('the registered 25 mN capability condition'); RFPConstraints.thrust_max_mN

absolute_thrust_gate.interpretation_open: Whether the 25 mN capability must also be shown within P_bus < 1.5 kW is not stated in the disposition; it is owner question HWQ-10. The derived thrust-per-bus-power floors for both readings are in derived_numbers.outputs.
absolute_thrust_gate.hardware_consequence: H-1, C-1, MC-1 and the common supplies must be designed for the RFP thrust band at P_bus < 1.5 kW (HW-ENV-05, HW-ENV-06). Whether they achieve it is what Phase 3 measures; this register predicts nothing.

configuration_items.name: Hall accelerator (one serial unit)
configuration_items.scope: channel, anode and gas distributor (the plane HALL_INLET_Z0 of lane 17), wall rings, body, rear inlet flange at IP-DN, thermocouple points

configuration_items.name: common magnetic circuit
configuration_items.scope: Hall coils or permanent magnets, pole pieces, magnetic screens of H-1, coil supplies in current control

configuration_items.name: cathode (one serial unit)
configuration_items.scope: hollow cathode with keeper and heater, its mount on H-1, its dedicated gas line and supplies

configuration_items.name: common feed system
configuration_items.scope: MFCs (N2, O2, Xe anode, Xe cathode), bottles, single mixing point and manifold, gas isolator (voltage break), line to IP-UP, capacitance manometer at the manifold

configuration_items.name: common electrical supplies
configuration_items.scope: discharge, magnet, keeper and heater supplies with load-plane metering (M2)

configuration_items.name: service-line bundle across the thrust stand
configuration_items.scope: every gas, power, RF coax, microwave feed, signal and thermocouple line crossing the stand, present in every configuration (arm-specific lines installed as shams in the other configurations, HW-SVC-01)

configuration_items.name: HW-0 flow-equivalent spacer
configuration_items.scope: between IP-UP and IP-DN; replicates the module mechanical envelope and gas path, no source hardware, no magnet (lane 25 HW-0)

configuration_items.name: removable RF pre-ionizer module
configuration_items.scope: RF source + interstage between IP-UP and IP-DN; off-module chain: DC-fed RF generator, matching network, directional coupler at the load plane

configuration_items.name: removable ECR pre-ionizer module
configuration_items.scope: ECR source + interstage + ECR magnet between IP-UP and IP-DN; off-module chain: DC-fed microwave generator, isolator, directional coupler, feed line to the coupling structure

configuration_items.name: OPTION-DIVERTER (only if D-06-B)
configuration_items.scope: in-vacuum feed-path switch between the module and a bypass to IP-DN

interface_planes.definition: module inlet plane: end of the common feed line (after the mixing point and the gas isolator). Fixed in the thrust-stand frame; the feed line upstream of it never moves or changes between configurations.

module outlet plane = H-1 rear inlet flange, immediately upstream of the anode/gas-distributor plane HALL_INLET_Z0 (lane 17 section 8). Everything downstream of IP-DN is H-1 and identical in every configuration.

lane 17 anode/gas-distributor plane at z = 0 (docs/architecture_comparison/hall_reference/hall_reference_v1.json injection_interface). The inlet state here is the only allowed physical difference between arms; it is a result, not a setting.

requirements.text: H-1, C-1 and the discharge supply shall operate over the owner-decided discharge-voltage set, identical in every arm (lane 17 INV-V1). PROPOSED design rating: cover the lane-17 relaxed alternative upper end so that the owner's choice between the strict and relaxed readings of rule VR-1 (lane 17 Q1) does not force a hardware change.

V_hi_iso_power_V.requires: TBD — requires the Hall design point and the bus allocation (lane 25 section 4, V_hi must bracket source-on bus power)

requirements.text: The discharge supply current rating shall at least cover the bus-compliance bound I_d <= P_max / V_d at the lowest V_d of the adopted set (derived_numbers.outputs.I_d_bound_envelope_max_A). Margin for ignition, extinction and knee-scan transients and for non-compliant diagnostic points is TBD.

transient_margin.requires: TBD — requires the supply protection design and the S1 ignition/extinction transients

requirements.text: The anode MFC ranges shall cover every valve-outlet test point {m_dot_s, P_feed, T_feed, x_s} of W1 (Phase 1 knee scan from m_dot_nom down to m_dot_min and back, Phase 2 common condition, Phase 3 representative envelope) on N2, O2 (air surrogate) and Xe (start, transfer, health check). Values are taken by reference, never copied here.

anode_flow_range.requires: TBD — requires the W1 feed-state closure test points (planned path docs/architecture_comparison/feed_state_closure/feed_state_closure_v1.json, fo_feed_state_closure, not merged at this base) and the lane-16 feed envelope (IF-A5)

xe_start_flow_range.requires: TBD — requires the lane-14 start parameters (all TBD in schemas/controls/dual_feed_state_machine_v1.json)

requirements.text: Feed pressure P_feed and temperature T_feed shall be measured at the manifold (and at the source chamber of a module) at every reading; their setpoints come from W1 by reference. With fixed hardware P_feed follows m_dot and conductance (lane 25 section 4); a mismatch with the W1 P_feed limits applicability and is reported, never corrected.

P_feed_range.requires: TBD — requires the W1 test points (fo_feed_state_closure)

T_feed_range.requires: TBD — requires the W1 test points and a feed thermal design (ICD IF-A5 T_gas_K is partial)

requirements.text: At every Phase-3 point the bus_power_boundary_v1 sum shall be below the RFP ceiling. The hardware's own consumers (hall_discharge, hall_magnet, cathode_keeper, cathode_heater, and in the source arms rf_source or ecr_source + ecr_magnet) are metered at their load planes; unmeasured common loads (compressor, flow_control, thermal_control, housekeeping) enter as LOCK-1 ledger inputs (package D-11). A necessary consequence at the 12 mN gate is the thrust-per-bus-power floor in derived_numbers.outputs.T_over_Pbus_floor_at_T_min_mN_per_kW.

hall_magnet_allocation_W.requires: TBD — requires the MC-1 design (coil or permanent magnet) and the bus allocation (lane 11)

requirements.text: H-1 shall be designed for the RFP thrust band on the delivered atmospheric feed at P_bus < 1.5 kW. The thrust stand range shall include the whole band (range and margin are W4's). This is a design target, not a predicted capability; Phase 3 measures it.

Working gases: N2; air surrogate N2 + O2 at the IF-A5 oxygen mass fraction with O + O2 supplied as O2 (lane 25 section 4); Xe for start, transfer, health check and cathode. No atomic-O source is part of the minimum hardware, so Phase 3 on the surrogate does not represent the atomic-O content of the delivered feed; this limitation is recorded with every Phase-3 result (HWQ-11).

x_O_feed.requires: TBD — requires IF-A5 w_s / x_s at the W1 test points

requirements.text: Accumulated campaign firing time per unit shall be estimated from the run matrix before LOCK-1, and H-1 and C-1 shall be inspected (dimensional, visual, mass) before S1, after each configuration's block series, and after the campaign. The campaign firing time is not a life demonstration.

campaign_firing_hours.requires: TBD — requires the LOCK-1 run matrix and the S1 dwell and settling times (lane 25 T-SUSTAIN dwell, T-SETTLE)

requirements.text: H-1 shall be the Vyovrinda design (experiment package D-09-A, PROPOSED, owner decision open). PROPOSED definition of 'design-representative' for evidence level 1: the channel geometry, magnetic-circuit design (B(z) shape at the design coil currents), anode and gas distributor, and wall grade of the Vyovrinda design release; lab-grade structure, heat sinking and fasteners are allowed if recorded and if the B(z) map shows no difference attributable to them. A surrogate unit gives evidence level 3, not verdict-bearing in lane 24 (D-09-B).

verification.method: inspection against the design release (drawing id, revision, sha256)

requirements.text: One serial H-1 unit is used for every configuration. If H-1 is replaced or repaired (any part downstream of IP-DN), the new state is a new unit H-1'; a new HW-0 reference and a new S1b series are required, and no paired comparison crosses the replacement.

The channel geometry (mean radius, width, length anode-to-exit, domain length to the cathode) shall be released with drawing id, revision and sha256 and measured as built before S1 and after the campaign. P5, ECHT and the 0-D HallChannel defaults are forbidden as design-value sources (lane 17 section 3).

geometry.requires: TBD — requires a Vyovrinda thruster design release

requirements.text: Channel wall grade: flight Hall channels use BN or BN-SiO2 (Goebel & Katz p. 325, lane 17 EV-G9); the ECHT used BN (lane 17 EV-G9). No measured N+, N2+, O+ or O2+ sputter yield on BN, BN-SiO2 or SiC was found in open sources, and O/N surface chemistry is outside every yield entry (lane 32 sections 1-2). The wall grade is therefore an owner/design decision (lane 17 Q6) that this experiment does not qualify for life. Requirement: one wall grade in every arm; erosion profile measured before S1, after each configuration's block series and after the campaign.

wall_grade.requires: TBD — requires the owner decision lane 17 Q6 and N/O coupon evidence (lane 32 H1-H4)

requirements.text: Anode and gas distributor shall be of a material or coating selected with evidence of oxidation behaviour in O2-bearing Hall discharges. Published evidence: after the PPS1350-TSD N2/O2 test the anode was 'rusty' and anode oxidation was named the main concern for endurance (Cifali et al. 2011 p. 5, as recorded in hall_sustainment E06); a PPS1350 on N2/O2 with 10 % Xe at 305 V ran about 314 h before anode oxidation caused flame-outs (Andreussi et al. 2022 p. 24, as recorded in lane 17 EV-W2). The anode is inspected (visual, mass) at every configuration change after O-bearing operation, and O-bearing points run last in every block (experiment package reconciliation, propellant ordering).

anode_material.requires: TBD — requires an anode material/coating decision with cited O2 oxidation evidence (owner, HWQ-08)

verification.stage: HRR, every configuration change after O-bearing operation, S6

requirements.text: The anode/gas-distributor hardware at HALL_INLET_Z0 is identical in all arms and belongs to H-1; every module attaches upstream of IP-DN (lane 17 INV-G3). No module part protrudes downstream of IP-DN.

Thermocouple points on the anode, the magnetic circuit (coil or pole) and the body at fixed, recorded positions, identical in every configuration (lane 25 M12). Thermal settling per T-SETTLE (TBD, S1) before every reading.

T_SETTLE.requires: TBD — requires the S1 thermal time constants (lane 25 T-SETTLE)

requirements.text: The Hall-probe path for B(z) mapping shall reach from beyond the exit plane down the channel to the anode face along the channel mean radius with any module installed, so that the mapped profile spans [0, domain] (HallThruster.jl holds B constant beyond the ends of the data; lane 17 section 4).

domain_length.requires: TBD — requires the cathode position (lane 17 geometry_interface domain_length_m)

requirements.text: One magnetic circuit, never modified between arms. Coil currents per operating point follow one pre-registered magnet_setting_schedule (lane 17 INV-B2). A per-arm coil re-trim (lane 37 D7, re-matched B(z)) is only a separately pre-registered sensitivity condition, never the architecture comparison.

magnet_setting_schedule.requires: TBD — requires the Vyovrinda magnetic-circuit design (lane 17 bfield_interface)

requirements.text: Coil supplies run in current control; each coil current is recorded with every reading and published with the B(z) maps (the P5 gap that made P5 transport non-identifiable). If MC-1 uses permanent magnets, hall_magnet is booked as 0 W with efficiency 1 (abep_sim/arch_boundary.py).

B(z) shall be mapped at the actual operating coil currents of every coil setting used, in every configuration and control state (M0, M0b, M0c where it exists), before and after each configuration's block series (lane 25 M11; lane 37 section 4). Maps carry coil currents, probe calibration, registration to the drawing (z = 0 at the anode face) and sha256.

bz_uncertainty.requires: TBD — requires the W4 instrumentation definition (fo_instrumentation_definition) and the INV-B3 tolerance (HWQ-04)

requirements.text: Hot-state field: B(z) mapping is magnetostatic at room temperature and its hot-state difference is TBD (lane 25 section 12). PROPOSED: a fixed reference field sensor on MC-1 outside the plasma, logged during firing, plus a cold re-map after each thermal soak with coils energized, to bound the hot-to-cold drift at fixed coil current. Feasibility (sensor temperature rating, location) TBD.

reference_sensor_location.requires: TBD — requires the MC-1 design and a sensor with a sufficient temperature rating (W4)

requirements.text: PROPOSED S1 addition (for the W2 LOCK-1 brief): on HW-0 at the S1b point, a coil-current scan gives the sensitivity S_B = d ln(T/P_bus) / d ln B. The owner's INV-B3 tolerance on a module-induced field change, epsilon_B, is then admissible only if |S_B| * epsilon_B stays within the variance share the owner assigns to it (formula; values from S1).

S_B.requires: TBD — requires the S1 coil-current scan on HW-0

epsilon_B_max.requires: TBD — requires S_B and an owner-assigned variance share (HWQ-04)

requirements.text: C-1 is a Xe-fed LaB6 hollow cathode (lane 17 section 6 and lane 19, both PROPOSED; owner confirms, HWQ-09). One serial unit, mounted on H-1 at a fixed recorded position that does not change when a module is exchanged; flow, keeper mode and heater protocol identical in every arm (lane 17 INV-C1).

cathode_position.requires: TBD — requires the H-1 design release and the cathode lane

requirements.text: C-1 emission capability shall cover I_emit = I_d + I_keeper + I_interstage (lane 19, Goebel & Katz Eqs. 7.2-24 to 7.2-26) at the discharge-current bound derived_numbers.outputs.I_d_bound_envelope_max_A plus the keeper and interstage currents. Reported Xe LaB6 lab range for context: 2-19 A (lane 10 dossier summary table); not a C-1 rating.

I_interstage_max.requires: TBD — requires the module electrical design (HW-ELEC-02) and lane 19

requirements.text: Poisoning protection: the emitter is heated only under Xe flow, Xe flow is maintained whenever the emitter is hot and O2-bearing gas is in the chamber, and a purge precedes heating (lane 14 design rationale 2). Evidence: O2 partial pressures in the 1e-5 Torr range degrade LaB6 emission below 1440 C, and LaB6 at 1570 C withstands up to 1e-4 Torr (Goebel & Katz Sec. 6.8.5, pp. 305-306, as recorded by lane 19); the emitter-region O2 partial pressure is not measurable directly and is TBD. The RAM-HET cathode could not be ignited after two days of N2/O2 testing; the accessed text does not attribute this to poisoning (IEPC-2017-377 pp. 7-8, as recorded by lane 19). C-1 health is tracked daily at a fixed Xe reference condition (keeper voltage, coupling voltage), aligned with the XE_HEALTH_CHECK (package D-15-B).

lab6_o2_degradation_onset_Torr.locator: cathode_integration_data_v1.json gk2008_o2_degradation_below_1440C (G&K Sec. 6.8.5 pp. 305-306; secondary statement of diode tests, lower edge of the stated decade)

lab6_o2_withstand_1570C_Torr.locator: cathode_integration_data_v1.json gk2008_o2_no_degradation_1570C (G&K Sec. 6.8.5 p. 306; secondary statement)

p_O_cathode_max.requires: TBD — requires atomic-O / O2 exposure evidence at the emitter (lane 10 gap G02, lane 19 U03)

requirements.text: The cathode gas has its own MFC and line, is identical in every arm, and never crosses HALL_INLET_Z0 (lane 17 CR-4). The air-fed cathode is excluded by design choice pending test (lane 14; ICD IF-A5 mdot_cathode_air_kgps held at zero).

Keeper and heater powers are metered at their load planes (bus components cathode_keeper, cathode_heater); cathode-to-ground and anode-to-ground potentials (coupling voltage) are recorded at every reading (lane 25 M14; the ECHT coupling voltage is missing, lane 37 section 4).
Thermal MFCs for N2, O2, Xe (anode) and Xe (cathode), calibrated on each gas in the final configuration, with identical setpoints across arms (experiment package REQ-HW-07; lane 25 M10).

One mixing point and manifold upstream of IP-UP, identical in all arms. All anode gas (Xe at start, then N2 or N2/O2) passes IP-UP; in HW-RF and HW-ECR it therefore passes the source, so the pre-ionizer can be brought up on Xe before any atmosphere is admitted (lane 14 design rationale 4). The Xe anode line joins at the same mixing point in every arm.

Start and transfer capability: ignition on Xe, then a smooth anode transfer from 100 % Xe to 100 % N2 or N2/O2 with the cathode on Xe, reversible back to Xe at every step. This order has direct published support: 'The PPS1350-TSD was always ignited with xenon. After ignition, a smooth transition from 100% xenon to 100% nitrogen or N2/O2 mixture at the anode was carried out; the cathode continued to work with xenon' (Cifali et al. 2011, as quoted by lane 14). Ramp rates, dwell times and thresholds are the lane-14 parameters (all TBD). Needed also for re-ignition after every extinction in the Phase-1 knee scan.

transfer_ramp_rate.requires: TBD — requires lane-14 parameter values (schemas/controls/dual_feed_state_machine_v1.json) and S1 demonstration

requirements.text: Pressure ports: capacitance manometer at the manifold in every configuration; a source-chamber port in each module and the same port (blanked or connected identically) in PIM-0, so the gas volume and port set seen by the feed do not differ except by the source hardware.

Flow equivalence of PIM-0: the same m_dot per species (same MFCs and setpoints) reaches HALL_INLET_Z0 through the same distributor; the manifold pressure at each grid flow is measured cold in every configuration in S1a and reported. The difference is part of R_install (lane 25 attribution split), never corrected.

leak_rate_max.requires: TBD — requires the leak-check method and the smallest grid flow (W1, W4)

requirements.text: The gas isolator (voltage break) is upstream of IP-UP and identical in every arm, so every module sees the same gas-line potential. Its voltage rating covers HW-ENV-01 V_d_rating_upper_V plus margin (margin TBD).

isolator_margin.requires: TBD — requires the facility electrical safety case and the supply design

requirements.text: O2 service: every wetted part of FS-C and the modules is oxygen-compatible and cleaned for O2 service; facility pump and safety compatibility with O2 flow is a facility requirement (package REQ-FAC-04).

o2_cleaning_standard.requires: TBD — requires the facility safety case (owner channel)

requirements.text: Every module mounts between IP-UP and IP-DN with the same flange pattern, alignment features, seals and torque specification. Exchanging a module changes nothing else: not H-1, C-1, MC-1, the feed path upstream of IP-UP, the stand mount, the service-line bundle, the grounding or the diagnostic positions.

interface_dimensions.requires: TBD — requires the H-1 rear-flange design and the module designs

requirements.text: PIM-0 replicates the module mechanical envelope and gas path with no source hardware and no magnet (lane 25 HW-0 definition), is non-ferromagnetic, and presents at IP-DN the same electrical potential as a module body (HW-ELEC-02).

Module and spacer structures are non-ferromagnetic; the only magnetic parts of a module are its declared magnet (ECR magnet, or an RF assist magnet only if HWQ-06 allows one). Verified by B(z) M0 vs M0b (lane 37 D6/D7).

ECR magnet type is an owner decision (HWQ-05) with stated consequences: an electromagnet allows the M0c state and on/off separation of the field perturbation (H6) and is booked as ecr_magnet coil power; a permanent magnet makes M0b = M0c, so H6 is bounded only by M0 vs M0b, B(z) in both states and the re-trimmed-coil condition (lane 37 section 3), and is booked as 0 W with efficiency 1. The test magnet type shall match the flight design intent, or the ecr_magnet ledger entry shall be the flight value (LOCK-1 input).

B_res_2p45GHz_T.locator: ecr_evidence_matrix.json ECR-E001 (875 G stated) and ECR-D001 (0.08752 T computed); recomputed in derived_numbers.outputs.B_res_ecr_2p45GHz_T

requirements.text: RF module magnetization: bus_power_boundary_v1 gives rf_hall only the component rf_source (net RF power at the coil/antenna terminals), with no slot for a DC assist magnet. Published RF sources on air species used an applied field to ignite at low flow (about 5 mT 'in most cases' for O2 and Ar; N2 ignited without it; RF-IAC18-01). PROPOSED: PIM-RF v1 is unmagnetized (ICP), or the owner and the bus-boundary lane define where an RF assist magnet is booked before LOCK-1 (HWQ-06). A contract change is outside this lane.

B_rf_ignition_assist_T.locator: rf_evidence_matrix.json RF-IAC18-01 (IAC-18 Sec. 7; on the electromagnet axis, IPG6-S)

requirements.text: The combined field in the Hall channel with a module installed (magnet fringe plus any change of MC-1 working point) shall equal the HW-0 B(z) within the owner's INV-B3 tolerance; otherwise that arm is not comparable (lane 17 INV-B3). Context: the 2.45 GHz resonance field is about 4.4 times the xenon-database typical Hall field (derived_numbers.outputs.ratio_B_res_2p45GHz_to_B_hall_typical; the denominator is a xenon value, not a Vyovrinda value), so the ECR magnet's fringe at the channel is a first-order design question. Tolerance and its derivation via S_B: HW-MC-05.

INV_B3_tolerance.requires: TBD — requires an owner decision (lane 17 Q5, HWQ-04) informed by the S1 sensitivity S_B

module_to_channel_distance.requires: TBD — requires the module and H-1 designs and a magnetostatic computation of the combined circuit

requirements.text: Each module provides access for the source-exit ion current I_src (guarded Faraday collector/array, lane 25 M5) and optionally an OES window (M13). Delivered current I_del is measured across the Hall channel exit with the Hall discharge off (S3), which needs no module port.

Each source shall be operable from P_lo to P_hi at the W1 grid flows on Xe (start) and on the working gases (lane 25 G-SRC bench stage S3). P_hi comes from the source allocation in bus_power_boundary_v1; P_lo = max(lowest stable, 0.5 P_hi) (lane 25 T-PLO-FRACTION, PROPOSED).

P_hi.requires: TBD — requires the source allocation in bus_power_boundary_v1 (owner, lane 11)

requirements.text: Module waste heat shall not reach H-1 through an unrecorded path: the module-to-H-1 conductive path at IP-DN is either thermally isolated by design or instrumented; the anode temperature is logged in every arm (HW-H1-07). A remaining anode-temperature difference between arms is reported with R_arch.

Plasma-facing module materials (RF dielectric tube, antenna or Faraday shield; ECR coupling structure and antenna) shall be O2-compatible. No accessed source measures erosion, sputtering or contamination of the RF dielectric tube, antenna or Faraday shield (RF evidence summary). Inspection before and after each module's campaign; mass-loss and deposit checks on H-1 surfaces downstream (module erosion products reach H-1 only in the source arms, a legitimate arm consequence that is recorded).

module_materials.requires: TBD — requires the RF and ECR module designs and cited O2-compatibility evidence

verification.stage: HRR, after each module's block series

requirements.text: Source frequencies are not selected. RF sources in the evidence base span about 1 MHz to 40.68 MHz (rf_evidence_matrix: NewOrbit 1-5 MHz, IPG6-S ~4 MHz, ICP 13.56 MHz, IPT 40.68 MHz); ECR candidates span 2.45 GHz to 5.8 GHz (ECR evidence: TBD, not selected). Feed-throughs, cables, matching networks and waveguides follow the selection.

requirements.text: RF and microwave chains: DC-fed generators preferred so their DC input is metered as efficiency evidence (lane 25 hardware list item 4-5); net power (forward minus reflected) is measured at the load plane (coil/antenna feed terminals; coupling-structure input), or reconstructed from an S1a-characterised loss with matched dummy loads (lane 25 M3; bus_power_boundary_v1 rf_source / ecr_source load planes). The vacuum feed-through and any cable or waveguide length inside the chamber are fixed per arm and characterised in S1a.

requirements.text: Only if the owner selects D-06-B: DIV-1 switches the anode gas between the module and a bypass to IP-DN without venting, is flow-equivalent in both positions (manifold pressure checked cold), is non-ferromagnetic, and is checked once against a true HW-0 (count TBD). PROPOSED design provision: IP-UP/IP-DN leave space for DIV-1 so D-06-B can be retrofitted without changing H-1.

requirements.text: Discharge supply between anode and cathode common; the thruster floats (Goebel & Katz Eqs. 7.2-21/22, via lane 17 section 5); the same supply topology, grounding scheme and cable routing in every arm (lane 17 INV-V2; lane 25 M14).

The electrical potential of every module body and of any interstage electrode is declared (floating, anode, cathode common or facility ground: owner decision HWQ-07), identical for PIM-0 at IP-DN, and any interstage current is measured, because it enters the cathode current budget I_emit = I_d + I_keeper + I_interstage (lane 19).

module_potential.requires: TBD — requires the module electrical design and an owner decision (HWQ-07)

requirements.text: RF and microwave returns are separated from the discharge return, and generator pickup on every common diagnostic is quantified with each generator driving a matched dummy load (no plasma, no flow) at each pre-registered power (lane 06 DUMMY_LOAD_PICKUP, adopted in S1a by the package reconciliation).

Every line crossing the thrust stand is present in every configuration: in HW-0 the RF coax and the microwave feed are installed as shams with the same routing and fixation (terminated off-stand), and likewise for the other arm in HW-RF and HW-ECR, so that stand stiffness, tare and thermal drift do not change with the arm. Engineering rationale (assumed): the installation term G5 does not average down (lane 25 section 6.4), so arm-dependent stand loading would enter R_arch directly.

End-to-end in-situ thrust-stand calibration under vacuum after every configuration change, with at least ten calibrations before and after operation, and the zero taken with power and flow off before thermal drift (Polk et al. 2017, as recorded by lane 25 M1; experiment package REQ-HW-01). Module mass differences change the stand's load, which is why calibration is per configuration.

calibrations_before_min.locator: experiment_package_v1.json REQ-HW-01 calibrations_before_min (recommended practice, lane 25 M1)

requirements.text: Installation (re-mount) reproducibility of ln(T/P_bus) shall be no worse than the lane-25 u_inst,max at the n fixed at LOCK-2 (package REQ-HW-04), unless a no-vent switch is adopted (D-06-B). PROPOSED hardware sub-allocation over five contributors with equal root-sum-square shares: (c1) stand calibration and zero shift, (c2) thrust-axis alignment, (c3) magnetic-circuit / B(z) change, (c4) gas path, distributor and leak change, (c5) service-line, thermal and electrical environment change. derived_numbers.outputs gives the per-contributor share and, as an example, the alignment-angle reproducibility whose cosine loss alone uses one share. Achievability is TBD — requires the S1b re-mount series.

PROPOSED configuration-change procedure: H-1 stays mounted on the stand and only the module between IP-UP and IP-DN is exchanged; the S1b re-mount cycle then replicates exactly that procedure. Lane 25 S1b currently describes removing and re-installing the spacer and the thruster mount; the owner chooses the procedure (HWQ-01), and S1b must replicate whichever is adopted.

Magnetic interaction of module magnets (and of MC-1) with the thrust stand's own magnetic or electromagnetic parts (calibrator, damper, displacement sensor) shall be checked by comparing the in-situ calibration with the ECR module installed, magnet on and off where possible.

owner_questions.question: Configuration-change procedure: exchange only the module with H-1 left on the stand (PROPOSED, HW-SVC-04) or re-mount H-1 each time (lane 25 S1b text)? S1b must replicate the adopted procedure. Also D-06 (A spacer / B diverter / C CFG-A / D CFG-B).
D-09: Vyovrinda design (level 1) or surrogate (level 3), and the PROPOSED definition of 'design-representative' in HW-H1-01.
V_d rating: rate H-1, C-1, supply and isolator to the relaxed 350 V end so that lane 17 Q1 does not force a hardware change?
INV-B3 tolerance on the module-induced field change, and whether to add the S1 coil-current sensitivity scan S_B (HW-MC-05) to LOCK-1.
ECR magnet: electromagnet (allows M0c, booked as coil power) or permanent magnet (M0b = M0c, 0 W); must match the flight design intent or the ledger must carry the flight value.
RF module magnetization: unmagnetized ICP in v1 (PROPOSED), or define with the bus-boundary lane where an RF assist-magnet's power is booked (no slot in bus_power_boundary_v1).
Electrical potential of the module body and any interstage electrode (floating / anode / cathode common / facility ground).
Anode/gas-distributor material or coating and the wall grade (lane 17 Q6), given the published anode-oxidation findings and the absence of N/O wall yields.
C-1: confirm the Xe-fed LaB6 hollow cathode and its emission rating against the derived I_d bound plus keeper and interstage currents.
Absolute gate: must the registered 25 mN capability be shown within P_bus < 1.5 kW (floor 16.67 mN/kW) or only the sustained 12 mN (floor 8.0 mN/kW)?
Atomic-O representativeness of Phase 3: accept the N2 + O2 surrogate with a recorded limitation, or add a dedicated atomic-O source (outside the minimum)?
Sham service lines on the stand in every configuration (HW-SVC-01).
Hot-state B reference sensor on MC-1 (HW-MC-04).
Spares policy: a replaced or repaired H-1 or C-1 is a new unit with a new HW-0 reference and S1b (HW-H1-02).
Whether the module interfaces are frozen before Phase 1 even if the modules are delivered later (PROPOSED, phases.P1), so that the Phase-1 HW-0 installation is valid for Phase 2.
